column2: Mean heart rate in beats per minute (bpm)
column3: HRᵢ = 60 ÷ (RRᵢ / 1000), where RRᵢ is the i-th NN interval in milliseconds. The average heart rate is then: HR̄ = (1/N) × Σ HRᵢ over all N beats

column2: Standard deviation of NN (normal-to-normal) intervals, in ms
column3: Computed directly from the cleaned RR intervals: SDNN = sqrt( (1 / (N − 1)) * Σ from i=1 to N of (RR(i) − mean(RR))2 where mean(RR) is the average of the RR intervals.

column2: Root mean square of successive differences
column3: Compute the successive differences: di = RR(i+1) − RR(i). Then compute the root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD): RMSSD = sqrt( (1 / (N − 1)) * Σ from i=1 to N−1 of (di2) )

column2: Number of successive RR differences greater than 50 ms
column3: Count how many satisfy: NN50 = Σ from i=1 to N−1 of 1(di > 50 ms), where 1(condition) is an indicator function that equals 1 if the condition is true and 0 otherwise
